topics.label: Lecture introduction to complement
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture opens with introductory framing and expectations regarding the complement system and its nomenclature.

topics.label: Fundamentals and central role of C3 in complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational principles of the complement system, its naming conventions, and the central role of C3.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three pathways that initiate complement activation and converge on the surface trigger threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the primary downstream effector functions responsible for clearing pathogens and stimulating inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation of complement on host cells
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the mechanisms that regulate complement activation to prevent damage to host tissues.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the diverse medical conditions and clinical presentations resulting from deficiencies in specific complement proteins.

topics.label: Pathogen strategies for complement evasion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the molecular strategies pathogens employ to avoid or disrupt complement-mediated immunity.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture closes with summary remarks and a preview of the next topic in the course.
